$comment: Reviewed exceptions to the retired-identity guard in scripts/docs-check.mjs. Each entry names one retired identity, the pattern that finds it, and the tracked files allowed to mention it, with the reason review accepted. Add a path only for history, a no-migration note, or a frozen app's own name; a live page that points a reader at a retired name does not belong here.
